name: scolia-backend
description: Backend SCOLIA : migrations Supabase, Edge Functions (Deno), tests RLS. Base de données : instance Supabase hébergée uniquement (pas de stack Docker locale).

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const glob=require('glob');const files=glob.sync('api/src/**/*.js').sort();let bad=0;for(const f of files){try{require('child_process').execSync('node --check '+f,{stdio:'pipe'});console.log('OK '+f);}catch(e){bad++;console.log('FAIL '+f);}}if(bad>0){process.exit(1);}"
